fact: The 2021 DHS found 85% of children under 5 (84.8% in SDG indicator 16.9.1) had their birth registered with the civil authorities and 73% had a birth certificate, below the 90% mark.
title: Burkina Faso Enquête Démographique et de Santé 2021
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INSD); ICF
